lede: The week's most consequential meeting is San Miguel County's Planning Commission on September 10th, where three Land Use Code amendments — covering forestry practices, oil and gas, and geothermal energy — are up for the Commission's formal recommendation before heading to the BOCC. Also worth tracking: SMART's board votes September 10th on its FY25 audit and a new investment advisor, and the Housing Code Update working group convenes September 15th to dig into proposed Community Housing provisions aimed at cutting red tape for affordable housing in unincorporated areas.
